evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: CounterCredit asks both questions of every image-returning call at its realized pre-call state, using the policy's own gold-answer score.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: A decision value compares the realized visual branch with answering immediately; an evidence value compares the returned crop with random same-size patches substituted into the same call.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: From the same cold start, prompt pool, and budget, CounterCredit reaches 89.5% on V*, 80.2% on HR-Bench-4K, and 76.4% on HR-Bench-8K, 6.3 to 9.4 points above outcome-only GRPO at 1.78 against 1.84 calls per question, and lowers the spurious-call rate to 31% to 36%, the lowest among the agents evaluated.
